observations.text: Autumn courses are open to learners aged 18 or older. Classes start on 2 November 2026. La fecha límite de inscripción es el 18 de octubre de 2026 a las 17:00. Enrollment closes on 18 October 2026 at 17:00 local time. How to apply
Read the enrollment guide, choose a class, then visit our public reception desk with proof of age. No online submission is required. Reception opens weekdays 09:00–17:00. Enrollment guide
